title: 3ARTH
tagline: It is a game that promotes the habits of keeping the Earth green by awarding NFTs.
description: In this game, the user will be able to grow trees, buy a water bottle and refill it, pick up trash and recycle.  Once the user reaches a certain level of greenness and cleans up the Earth, it will reward the user with in-game currency which could then be used to redeemed as a NFT.
how_its_made: I plan to use IPFS to store the data, EPNS to push notifications, XMTP and other technologies if I can.  I want to deploy on the Polygon network and use Superfluid and Worldcoin and Optimism.  It is written in Javascipt and React and CSS and HTML.  I plan to work on the basic functionality of doing actions.
